title: 自然之神的藤

titles.en: Vines of the God of Nature

text: 祭坛已经被藤蔓裹住，缝隙里长出小小的白花。藤蔓里托着一枚木牌，像是专为你留的。

texts.en: Vines have wrapped the altar, and small white flowers grow from the cracks. Cradled in the vines is a wooden token, as if left there just for you.

outcomes.text: 自然之神的护符上，藤还在长。

texts.en: On the charm of the God of Nature, the vine is still growing.
